note: Sample launch / conversion alerts. Illustrative only — not live FDA Purple Book feeds.

alerts.title: New ustekinumab biosimilar wave vs Stelara
alerts.message: Multiple ustekinumab biosimilars are on market. Sample seed shows elevated brand share among dermatology and GI cohorts in TX, FL, and CA — conversion opportunity for preferred-product steering.

alerts.title: Interchangeable adalimumab (Cyltezo) underutilized
alerts.message: Cyltezo carries interchangeable designation. Peer-group biosimilar share remains low in several rheumatology territories in the sample set.

alerts.title: Insulin glargine: Semglee / Rezvoglar gap
alerts.message: Interchangeable glargine products exist; sample endocrinology and primary-care NPIs still skew to reference brand cost.

alerts.title: Ranibizumab interchangeable (Cimerli) vs Lucentis
alerts.message: Ophthalmology sample panels show brand-heavy mix; formulary preferred biosimilar adoption is incomplete in NY and FL cohorts.

alerts.title: Pegfilgrastim brand persistence in oncology
alerts.message: Mature biosimilar class; sample medical oncology NPIs still drive material brand cost — classic PBM conversion target.

alerts.title: Filgrastim: Zarxio / Nivestym share lag
alerts.message: Lower absolute spend than other families, but high conversion feasibility where onboarding is incomplete.
